title: bounded DOCX paragraph-index memo design

probe.semantic_assertion: paragraph_count() == expected paragraph count inside every counted iteration
probe.allocation_region: counters snapshotted immediately before and after the measured loop
probe.source_diagnostics: printed after the sampled allocator delta

ownership_findings: A fresh eager DocumentPart creates a fresh paragraph OnceLock and repeats the index build.
A source payload is physically cached after one cold load, but each fresh source-backed document repeats the semantic index build.
The current managed DocumentIndexAdmission is xml_len/4+1 range slots, 24 bytes per slot plus 1024 bytes, and range slots plus 3 objects.
A package-owned semantic memo must not move PartData or physical cache ownership across the litchi-docx/litchi-opc boundary.

next_implementation.weight: checked retained range bytes plus measured fixed memo/Arc envelope
next_implementation.clean_ceiling: initial eight-MiB policy derived from the one-million-range safety bound
next_implementation.eviction: explicit trim_clean(required_weight) on generation, admission, and pressure paths; pinned active values remain charged
next_implementation.oversized_value: return to active view but bypass clean-cache publication and recompute later
